name: MediBot
summary: Log corrections, time-marks, and patient questions to the live MediBot chart by voice.
description: Ambient AI crew member for paramedics. Logs corrections, time-marks, and questions to the live patient chart by voice.

tools.name: medibot_correction
tools.title: Log a chart correction
tools.description: Call when the user says 'correction' followed by corrected patient data, e.g. 'correction — BP 90 over 60' or 'correction, the patient takes warfarin not heparin'. Records a non-destructive amendment to the patient chart. Pass the corrected fact exactly as spoken, without the word 'correction'.

text.description: The corrected fact exactly as spoken, e.g. 'BP 90 over 60'

tools.name: medibot_mark
tools.title: Mark an event time
tools.description: Call when the user asks MediBot to mark, log, or timestamp a clinical moment, e.g. 'MediBot, mark epi given', 'mark time of arrest', 'mark ROSC'. Stamps the event on the patient timeline at the current time.

tools.name: medibot_ask
tools.title: Ask MediBot about the patient
tools.description: Call when the user asks MediBot a question about the patient, medications, vitals, or incident timeline, e.g. 'MediBot, when was the last epi?', 'MediBot, what's the latest blood pressure?'. The question is logged and MediBot answers out loud.
